purpose: FiveM graphics and texture resources with links to the original creators and verified author previews.

items.previewCaption: Still from Hiromasa’s OPTI V7 showcase.
items.name: Hiromasa OPTI V7 Free
items.author: Hiromasa
items.description: Performance-oriented client graphics pack with revised weather, water and lighting.
requirements: Use the free V7 package listed by Hiromasa. Extract the archive and follow the creator’s FiveM plugins-folder guide.

items.previewCaption: Original in-game screenshot from the Glint release.
items.name: Glint 1.0 + GlintVisuals
items.author: Glint
items.credits: Glint. Timecycles and weather by Dee.
items.description: A ReShade add-on and companion visual pack for lighting, reflections, volumetric weather and updated textures.
requirements: FiveM for GTA V Legacy with DirectX 11 and ReShade.
Choose the GlintVisuals.rpf FiveM build. The release author notes a substantial GPU cost.

items.previewCaption: Before and after comparison by PrimeGraphics.
items.name: Realistic Coast RolePlay Preset
items.author: PrimeGraphics
items.description: A coastal color grade with cooler blues, stronger contrast and film grain.
requirements: FiveM for GTA V Legacy and ReShade with the shaders named in the release.
CoreFX is recommended by the author. Place the .ini in the ReShade presets folder and select it in the overlay.

items.previewCaption: Original gameplay screenshot from UniT’s ClearVibe preset gallery.
items.name: UniT ClearVibe Preset
items.author: UniT Presets
items.description: Free ClearVibe ReShade preset tuned for the QuantV version of FiveM.
requirements: FiveM for GTA V Legacy, QuantV and ReShade.
Choose the ClearVibe preset under Free presets and follow the author's instructions for loading it in ReShade.

items.previewCaption: Original screenshot from SLmodding’s California Roads April release.
items.name: California Roads
items.author: SLmodding
items.credits: SLmodding. Leoncoder credited for the original FiveM port.
items.description: California-style road textures for Los Santos, including revised asphalt and lane markings.
requirements: Select 0.6 April FiveM in All Versions on the author’s release page.
Follow the FiveM build’s instructions and check it against the target game and server build.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM · Choose the 0.6 April FiveM build

items.previewCaption: Original map screenshot from Oulsen’s Cfx.re release post.
items.name: Oulsen Satellite Map
items.author: Oulsen
items.description: A server-streamed satellite minimap with custom postals, street labels and an optional no-grid version.
items.license: MIT for the source repository. The README credits the base map and streaming code separately.
requirements: FiveM server with permission to install resources.
Keep the oulsen_satmap resource intact. Follow the README to enable it and choose the grid or no-grid textures.
